Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Macrame Fringe Lumbar Throw Pillow - 18 x 12 Inch, Blue
Colors: Blue
Imported This stylish modern throw pillow features a sky blue fabric and matching macramé fringe for a tasseled bohemian aesthetic that can set your space apart. 18"L x 12"W macramé fringe; hidden zipper closure Pillow cover and insert Spot clean only.
